charged_frame: Frozen GJ left charged-lepton frame of 1659, assumed applicable to the low-energy weak-current frame; no running or charged-vectorlike mixing is added.

hflav.which: Pure leptonic Eqs. (6),(8) and Table 5, in the order g_tau/g_mu, g_mu/g_e.

pienu.which: Standalone PIENU charged-current coupling ratio g_e/g_mu.

scope: All extra neutral mass eigenstates kinematically inaccessible in pion, muon and tau decays. Tree-level Dirac active-singlet mixing after electroweak breaking, common left family couplings, massless light-limit residue. Other weak vertex operators and extra decay channels absent. Established radiative and phase-space corrections used in the published coupling ratios.
